$Comment: A step of Old Jack's questline: buy a Grave Candle at his stall, go into the Horseman's Graveyard
through the Gravekeeper beside him and bring the Headless Horseman down, then report back. He
offers it beside his five errands, on his rider_offer screen and on his quest list (his "What
needs doing?"); while it is being carried, his conversation opens on his rider line, which says
where the Gravekeeper stands, that his gate wants a Grave Candle from the stall, and how the head
works, and once it is done he asks for the hand-in. Its Listing puts it on the
hallows_eve_old_jack ladder after the errands (Tier 6), before the hard ride (Fire for the
Lantern, Tier 7), which asks for it, and the Hollow Lantern; the Parent makes it a main quest.
The _Hallows_Eve folder makes the id hallows_eve_old_jack_horseman.
The two steps share Order 1, so they count in either order: buy_grave_candle (LOOT_RECEIVED ticks
when a payout hands the player a Grave Candle, which buying one at Old Jack's stall is; Qualifier
is left out, so any payout of one counts, and only the stall pays one; it never takes the candle,
which the Gravekeeper burns at the gate) and bring_down_horseman. A partymate carrying this quest
who follows a party in free (the party spends one candle between them) can beat him first and buy
a candle after. A candle bought before the quest was taken does not count. Give the defeat step a
higher Order to make the candle come first.
ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names his fight's script, never a creature, so it holds through his change of
form, and every player the fight credits counts the win, however many fought; only players
carrying the quest when he falls move it. Npc.TurnInId, which the Parent sets, adds the
report-back step to Old Jack one Order past the highest here, so it opens only once both steps
are done, and he stands in the Forgotten Temple for the whole season.
Requires opens it once a player has finished Lanterns in the Temple, or Pumpkin Patch for a
player who went straight to Old Jack's questline. Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each
Hallow's Eve (Times is how often one run takes it), so a returning player rides against him again
next October; one left unfinished when the event ends waits for the next.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its
own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Old_Jack_Horseman
